title: fusion.implementer-result/v1
description: Frozen at plan step 15 on Prior's answer 69 at a4f463f: the code-implementer's domain result, the profile's result_schema and the object the host places in the role input as output_contract. It is the three-field report the role's neutral text mandates (agents/code-implementer.md, Report shape): the files changed, one verification entry per check run, each naming the frozen check it covers and taking exactly one of three exclusive forms, and a result the verification decides. done requires at least one verification entry and every entry of the exit form with exit code 0; any other entry makes the result blocked, and the implement step of workflows/repair.v1.json stops as escalated on blocked. A host that grants no process.check may leave the implementer to report blocked, which neither relaxes done nor bypasses a check. The result is a claim: the host checks one-to-one coverage of the frozen mandatory check names against its own receipts, host.capture.v1 captures the change and runs every check itself, host.integrate.v1 runs them again, and a change outside the write scope refuses the attempt whatever this object says. Prior's embedded contract at 167c605 (modules/fusion/roles/roles.go, outcome and summary) is replaced by this one on the ruling that fusion authors the output contract (67.7); old runs under that contract stay readable under their original formats and pins and are not decoded by this schema. No $schema keyword: the host compiles every bundle schema as draft 2020-12 and this file must carry no URL.

files_changed.description: Every file the implementer modified, as absolute paths under workspace.root of the role input, which is what the neutral text mandates; empty when it changed nothing. The host relates them to write_paths by stripping the root, and host.capture.v1 decides from the tree, not from this list.

verification.description: One entry per check the implementer ran, each naming the frozen check. exit: it ran and read the code; command and exit_code, no detail. did-not-finish: it started and never returned a code; command and detail, no exit_code. none: nothing was run, and detail says why; neither command nor exit_code. At least one entry, never left out.

check.description: The name of the frozen check this entry covers, one of the role input's checks[].name; the host matches it against its own receipt.

command.description: The command as the host displayed it for the check, echoed; the implementer chose the check by name through process_check and never argv.

detail.description: What stopped it (did-not-finish) or why nothing ran (none).

result.description: done or blocked; the verification entries decide which.
